visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Wrong Formula in the Setter
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Setting 212 degrees Fahrenheit should give 100 degrees Celsius, but the program prints 324.

solution.explanation: To convert Fahrenheit to Celsius you multiply by 5/9. Multiplying by 9/5 is the opposite conversion (Celsius to Fahrenheit), which gives 324 instead of 100.
